newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products hit by falling crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products hit by falling crude.

text.p: NWE oil products were weaker on Thursday, traders said.
Naphtha fell by up to $3 a tonne reflecting poor demand and sharp drops on crude.
Gas oil weakened by up to $2.50 a tonne, although stronger barge premiums lessened the impact on outright prices.
Gasoline fell with Brent and NYMEX futures. March Eurograde barges were assessed at around $205 fob ARA.
High sulphur fuel oil was little changed although still well offered. Low sulphur fuel oil was around $3 weaker.
